headline: Vikings reunite with Kirk Cousins in deadline-day trade

top.headline: Vikings reunite with Kirk Cousins in deadline-day trade
top.summary: The Vikings got quarterback Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a 2027 third-round pick. The 6-2 Vikings made the deal a day after a 23-6 loss to Buffalo in which they didn't score a touchdown and Carson Wentz threw for 81 yards. No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza is expected to start for the Raiders against Seattle this week.

top.headline: Colts keep Jonathan Taylor, trade Josh Downs and Keenan Allen
top.summary: The Colts turned down offers of second-round picks for running back Jonathan Taylor and wanted at least a first-rounder, per NFL Network's Tom Pelissero. Indianapolis still moved two receivers: Josh Downs to the Chiefs and Keenan Allen to the 49ers.

top.headline: Blazers beat Thunder 123-103
top.summary: Portland outscored Oklahoma City 38-21 in the third quarter and pulled away. Damian Lillard had 25 points and Deni Avdija had 24 points and 8 assists. The Blazers are 7-3, and the two teams meet again Wednesday night.

stories.headline: Vikings reunite with Kirk Cousins in deadline-day trade
stories.summary: The Vikings got quarterback Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a 2027 third-round pick. The 6-2 Vikings made the deal a day after a 23-6 loss to Buffalo in which they didn't score a touchdown and Carson Wentz threw for 81 yards. No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza is expected to start for the Raiders against Seattle this week.

stories.headline: Colts keep Jonathan Taylor, trade Josh Downs and Keenan Allen
stories.summary: The Colts turned down offers of second-round picks for running back Jonathan Taylor and wanted at least a first-rounder, per NFL Network's Tom Pelissero. Indianapolis still moved two receivers: Josh Downs to the Chiefs and Keenan Allen to the 49ers.

stories.headline: Bengals back out of Arnold Ebiketie trade
stories.summary: Cincinnati had agreed to get edge rusher Arnold Ebiketie from the Eagles for a sixth-round pick, then called the deal off. Per The Cincinnati Enquirer, completing it would have cost the Bengals a third-round compensatory pick they expect for losing Trey Hendrickson to Baltimore. The team declined to comment.

stories.headline: Bills, Broncos, Ravens make late deadline additions
stories.summary: The Bills got safety Amani Hooker and a 2027 fifth from the Titans for a 2027 second-rounder. The Broncos added linebacker Daiyan Henley from the Chargers, and the Ravens got center Ryan Neuzil from the Falcons. NFL.com counted six trades on deadline day.

stories.headline: Dolphins DT Zach Sieler out for the season
stories.summary: Zach Sieler tore his biceps early in Sunday's loss to the Lions and will have season-ending surgery, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported. He played the rest of that game.

leagues.name: NBA
leagues.summary: Blazers beat Thunder by 20; Knicks win fourth straight as Bucks drop to 1-10; Franz Wagner's 33 ends Magic skid; Kawhi out another week

stories.headline: Blazers beat Thunder 123-103
stories.summary: Portland outscored Oklahoma City 38-21 in the third quarter and pulled away. Damian Lillard had 25 points and Deni Avdija had 24 points and 8 assists. The Blazers are 7-3, and the two teams meet again Wednesday night.

stories.headline: Knicks win fourth straight, Bucks lose seventh in a row
stories.summary: New York beat Milwaukee 117-85 behind Karl-Anthony Towns' 21 points and 16 rebounds and Jalen Brunson's 23. The Knicks are 6-4 after an 0-3 start. The Bucks fell to 1-10.

stories.headline: Wagner's 33 ends Magic skid; Acuff nears a Jordan rookie mark
stories.summary: Franz Wagner scored a season-high 33 as Orlando won 107-100 in Sacramento to snap a four-game losing streak. Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 29 and has 288 points through 11 games, the most by a rookie in that span since Michael Jordan's 289 in 1984. Sacramento is 0-6 at home.

stories.headline: Giannis has 30 and 11 as Heat hold off Jazz
stories.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo had 30 points and 11 rebounds in Miami's 115-109 win, after Utah outscored the Heat 37-23 in the fourth. The Jazz have lost nine straight and their 1-10 record is the worst in the West.

stories.headline: Kawhi Leonard out at least one more week
stories.summary: The Raptors said Leonard will miss at least another week while he reconditions after treatment for swelling in his left knee. He has been out since Oct. 23. Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley have each missed two straight games.

standouts.name: Franz Wagner
standouts.note: A season high, with 10 of 10 at the line, as Orlando snapped a four-game skid.

standouts.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
standouts.note: Carried Miami to a road win as Utah's losing streak reached nine.

standouts.name: Damian Lillard
standouts.note: Scored 13 in the third quarter as Portland pulled away from Oklahoma City.

moves.text: Lakers to sign C Carson Cooper to a two-way deal after the Grizzlies waived him

leagues.name: NHL
leagues.summary: Mercer scores twice as Jets beat Hellebuyck's Devils; Leafs drop fourth straight; Saros blanks Kings; Barkov and Marchand back on the ice

stories.headline: Mercer burns former team as Jets snap Devils' streak
stories.summary: Dawson Mercer scored twice, including the go-ahead power-play goal early in the third, and Nico Daws made 19 saves for his first Winnipeg win in a 4-2 victory. Connor Hellebuyck, traded to New Jersey in the deal that sent both to Winnipeg, did not play. The Jets have won four straight; the Devils' five-game win streak is over.

stories.headline: Landeskog scores twice as Avalanche hand Maple Leafs fourth straight loss
stories.summary: Gabriel Landeskog had two goals, including the go-ahead goal in the third, and Cale Makar added two assists in Colorado's 6-3 win in Toronto. The Maple Leafs are 8-10-2.

stories.headline: Barkov, Marchand skate with Panthers, could return within two weeks
stories.summary: Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand skated with Florida for the first time since getting hurt in early October. Coach Paul Maurice said they could return within two weeks. The Panthers won 4-1 at Columbus later Tuesday.

stories.headline: Saros shuts out Kings; Forsberg scores twice
stories.summary: Juuse Saros stopped all 30 shots and Filip Forsberg scored twice in Nashville's 3-0 win in Los Angeles. The Kings had been favored.

standouts.name: Juuse Saros
standouts.note: Stopped everything in a shutout in Los Angeles.

standouts.name: Jacob Markstrom
standouts.note: Made 37 saves on 38 shots in a 4-1 win at Columbus.

standouts.name: Dawson Mercer
standouts.note: Scored twice against his former team, including the go-ahead power-play goal.

leagues.name: MLB
leagues.summary: Offseason · Murphy and Venable win Manager of the Year; Cy Young winners announced today

stories.headline: Pat Murphy wins third straight NL Manager of the Year; Will Venable takes AL
stories.summary: Milwaukee's Pat Murphy became the first manager to win the award three years in a row, getting 20 of 30 first-place votes after the Brewers won a franchise-record 103 games and the World Series. Chicago's Will Venable won the AL award after the White Sox went 84-78 and became the first team to make the playoffs after back-to-back 100-loss seasons.

stories.headline: Rangers plan to explore Corey Seager trades
stories.summary: Per The Athletic and the Dallas Morning News, Texas will test the market for its shortstop at the GM meetings. Seager is owed about $155MM over five years and has full no-trade rights. Teams have a few weeks to deal before a widely expected lockout after the CBA expires Dec. 1.

stories.headline: Mets set to meet with Tarik Skubal
stories.summary: The Mets are scheduled to meet next week with Skubal, the top free agent, per the New York Post. He reportedly hopes to sign before the expected lockout, and because he was traded midseason, signing him costs no draft picks.
